content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] [version_no]. I want to control a proportional solenoid valve by having the [product_name] output a variable current of 0-1000 mA using the PWM function. Is this possible?

No, this is not possible. You would need an expansion module for the [product_name], but it provides either a 0-10 Volt or a 0 (or 4)-20 mA signal. The relevant module is the [product_name] [article_no]. With two resistors, you can convert a 0-10 Volt signal into a 0-1 Volt range.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked if their [product_name] [version_no] could directly provide a variable current output (0-1000 mA) using PWM to control a proportional solenoid valve. The response explained this is not possible with the base model and stated an expansion module is required for analog output, though the available signal ranges differ from what the user requested.
